crossRefs.note: Then the Spirit came on Amasai, who was chief of the thirty, and he said, “We are yours, David, and on your side, you…
Of the increase of his government and of peace there shall be no end, on David’s throne, and on his kingdom, to…
All your children will be taught by Yahweh; and your children’s peace will be great.
Peace I leave with you. My peace I give to you; not as the world gives, I give to you. Don’t let your heart be…
Now the fruit of righteousness is sown in peace by those who make peace.
God has shown himself in her citadels as a refuge.

translations.web: Peace be within your walls, and prosperity within your palaces.
translations.bsb: May there be peace within your walls, and prosperity inside your fortresses.”
translations.kjv: Peace be within thy walls, and prosperity within thy palaces.
translations.asv: Peace be within thy walls, And prosperity within thy palaces.
